## What you did
- You fixed the flaky `test_acs_rejects_expired_assertion` by freezing time instead of sleeping, and applied the same fix to the two other timing-dependent tests. [1]
- You cleaned up `kestrel/auth` for ruff 0.8 and mypy: missing Issuer/Subject in assertions now raise a proper validation error instead of a 500, and you split the 900-line `saml_utils.py` into `saml/{assertions,metadata,bindings}` with a shim keeping old imports working. All shipped as PR #423. [1]

## What changed
- Maya approved and merged PR #418 (SAML signature verification) — it goes out with tonight's staging deploy, so the Wednesday deadline for the Fernhill walkthrough on Thursday is met. She left one non-blocking nit on an error message wording. [3]
- Tom requested changes on #423: the module move and the lint fixes are mixed in a 1,900-line diff and he can't see the real changes. Split it into two PRs and he'll approve both today. [4]

## What is still open
- Split #423 into two PRs (cleanup vs module move) to unblock Tom's review. [4]
- Move the SAML replay cache from in-memory TTLCache to Redis so a replayed assertion can't hit another pod — your planned task for today, roughly 40 lines using the existing client in `kestrel/cache.py`. [1]
